svg.title: MedMe updated user flow — service, time, unit, token chain
svg.desc: Complete parallel flow for Patient, Professional and Clinic. Time is selected before unit — the non-obvious IA decision. Three token moments shown.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why does MedMe ask for service type before anything else?')
sendPrompt('Why does the patient pick a time before seeing units?')
sendPrompt('How are units filtered by the selected time slot?')
sendPrompt('How does the clinic publish availability for each time slot?')
sendPrompt('What does the patient review before paying?')
sendPrompt('Why does the clinic assign the professional, not the patient?')
sendPrompt('How does the escrow payment work at booking?')
sendPrompt('What does the professional receive when a booking is confirmed?')
sendPrompt('What does the clinic log when a booking is confirmed?')
sendPrompt('Why does the professional need Token 1 before going to the patient?')
sendPrompt('What does Token 1 track for the clinic?')
sendPrompt('How does Token 2 confirm the right professional is at the door?')
sendPrompt('What does Token 2 document for the professional?')
sendPrompt('How does Token 3 trigger payment release?')
sendPrompt('What triggers payment to the clinic?')
sendPrompt('What does the clinic see when Token 3 closes?')
